messages.subject: Apologise for spam mail
parts:
Dear people in my address list

An email was sent last week to my entire contact list, inviting people to
join something called Hi5. It was not my intention to send this email to all
my contacts and I sincerely apologize if you have been spammed by me.

If you do choose to accept the invitation to join Hi5, be careful and avoid
spamming your whole address list, as I did. It can be very embarrassing to
contact each and every person in your address list with an invitation to
join an Internet network. Especially when you do not know what are the the
implications of joining this network.

All the best, and I am very sorry

Fernando Ugarte
